tools.name: zomentum_list_opportunities
tools.description: List sales opportunities (deals) with name, stage, value, close date, owner and client company. Optionally limit to one pipeline. Zomentum API: GET /v2/opportunities/.

tools.name: zomentum_get_opportunity
tools.description: Fetch one opportunity with its stage, value, close date, linked contacts, documents and comments. Zomentum API: GET /v2/opportunities/{id}/.

tools.name: zomentum_count_opportunities
tools.description: Count opportunities per pipeline stage, for a pipeline dashboard. Zomentum API: GET /v2/opportunities/count/.

tools.name: zomentum_list_pipelines
tools.description: List the sales pipelines and their stages. Use the ids with the opportunity tools. Zomentum API: GET /v2/pipelines/.

tools.name: zomentum_get_pipeline
tools.description: Fetch one pipeline with its stages. Zomentum API: GET /v2/pipelines/{id}/.

tools.name: zomentum_search
tools.description: Search across opportunities, client companies, documents, catalog items, users and suppliers by text. Results show only the types the API user may read. Zomentum API: GET /v2/search/.

tools.name: zomentum_list_client_companies
tools.description: List client companies (customers and prospects) with market, source, owner and opportunity count. Zomentum API: GET /v2/client/companies/.

tools.name: zomentum_get_client_company
tools.description: Fetch one client company with its contacts, opportunities and comments. Zomentum API: GET /v2/client/companies/{id}/.

tools.name: zomentum_list_client_users
tools.description: List client contacts (people at client companies) with email, phone, job title and company. Zomentum API: GET /v2/client/users/.

tools.name: zomentum_get_client_user
tools.description: Fetch one client contact. Zomentum API: GET /v2/client/users/{id}/.

tools.name: zomentum_list_documents
tools.description: List documents (quotes, proposals, orders and similar) with status, number, recipients and linked opportunity. Zomentum API: GET /v2/documents/.

tools.name: zomentum_get_document
tools.description: Fetch one document with its status, revisions, recipients and signers. Zomentum API: GET /v2/documents/{id}/.

tools.name: zomentum_get_document_download_url
tools.description: Return a signed, short-lived URL to download one document as PDF. Share it only with people who may read the document. Zomentum API: GET /v2/documents/download_url/{id}/.

tools.name: zomentum_list_items
tools.description: List catalog items (products and services) with pricing, category, manufacturer and SKU. Zomentum API: GET /v2/items/.

tools.name: zomentum_get_item
tools.description: Fetch one catalog item with its pricing, optionally in one currency. Zomentum API: GET /v2/items/{id}/.

tools.name: zomentum_list_activities
tools.description: List all sales activities (tasks, meetings, calls and emails) in the workspace. Zomentum API: GET /v2/activities/.

tools.name: zomentum_list_tasks
tools.description: List sales tasks with title, due date, priority, completion state and linked record. Zomentum API: GET /v2/activities/sales/task/.

tools.name: zomentum_list_meetings
tools.description: List sales meetings with title, start and end time, attendees and linked record. Zomentum API: GET /v2/activities/sales/meeting/.

tools.name: zomentum_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers with name, email and drop-ship or electronic PO flags. Zomentum API: GET /v2/supplier/.

tools.name: zomentum_list_users
tools.description: List the team members of the company with email, job title, roles and whether they are disabled. Zomentum API: GET /v2/users/.

tools.name: zomentum_get_user
tools.description: Fetch one team member with roles and settings. Zomentum API: GET /v2/users/{id}/.

tools.name: zomentum_list_tags
tools.description: List tags with the entity type each tag applies to and its colour. Zomentum API: GET /v2/tags/.

tools.name: zomentum_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the custom field definitions for one entity type, to read custom field ids and dropdown values. Zomentum API: GET /v2/custom/fields/.

tools.name: zomentum_create_task
tools.description: Create an open sales task (not completed), with a due date and an optional link to an opportunity, client company or contact. The author must be a team member id. Zomentum API: POST /v2/activities/sales/task/.

tools.name: zomentum_add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to an opportunity, client company, document or other record. The author must be a team member id. Zomentum API: POST /v2/comments/.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: zomentum_get_opportunity, zomentum_get_client_company, zomentum_list_client_users, zomentum_get_document_download_url, zomentum_list_activities, zomentum_list_suppliers, zomentum_list_users, zomentum_create_task · Private data: zomentum_get_opportunity, zomentum_search, zomentum_get_client_company, zomentum_list_client_users, zomentum_get_client_user, zomentum_list_documents, zomentum_get_document, zomentum_get_document_download_url, zomentum_list_tasks, zomentum_list_meetings, zomentum_create_task, zomentum_add_comment · Public sink: zomentum_list_client_users, zomentum_get_document_download_url, zomentum_list_suppliers, zomentum_list_users, zomentum_create_task, zomentum_add_comment · Destructive: zomentum_list_suppliers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: zomentum_get_opportunity, zomentum_get_client_company, zomentum_list_client_users, zomentum_get_document_download_url, zomentum_list_activities, zomentum_list_suppliers, zomentum_list_users, zomentum_create_task · Private data: zomentum_get_opportunity, zomentum_search, zomentum_get_client_company, zomentum_list_client_users, zomentum_get_client_user, zomentum_list_documents, zomentum_get_document, zomentum_get_document_download_url, zomentum_list_tasks, zomentum_list_meetings, zomentum_create_task, zomentum_add_comment · Public sink: zomentum_list_client_users, zomentum_get_document_download_url, zomentum_list_suppliers, zomentum_list_users, zomentum_create_task, zomentum_add_comment · Destructive: zomentum_list_suppliers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
